capabilities: Render Yandex Tracker issues in notes using code-block syntax
Render inline issue links such as ST:YT-123 as chips or external links
Render Tracker queries and customize the issue link template
Configure Tracker API credentials, organization ID, and language in settings
extras: Unofficial plugin: README states it is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or supported by Yandex. Real API calls are made only during rendering after credentials are configured; API and organization setup details are deferred to the public Tracker API access documentation.
problem: Obsidian notes cannot display live Yandex Tracker issue data or query results without copy-pasting them manually.

relations.evidence: Render Yandex Tracker issues and queries directly in Obsidian notes.

requires.name: OAuth or IAM token (settings or token file)

summary: Renders Yandex Tracker issues and queries inside notes via code-block syntax and inline ST:YT-123 issue links, using the Tracker API.
